title: Bank of Canada: Rate path risks tilt earlier – RBC
summary: Nathan Janzen at Royal Bank of Canada (RBC) notes that markets are focused on whether the Bank of Canada (BoC) will raise rates in October after the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) move.

title: European Central Bank: Quarterly hikes still baseline – Nordea
summary: Nordea’s team sees the European Central Bank delivering two more 25bp rate hikes, in December and March 2027, despite more aggressive market pricing.

title: Euro heads for weekly loss against US Dollar on hawkish Fed outlook
summary: EUR/USD remains on the defensive on Friday and heads for a weekly loss as the Federal Reserve’s (Fed) hawkish policy outlook keeps the US Dollar (USD) firmly supported. A rebound in Oil prices and US Treasury yields adds pressure on the pair.
